summary: The sole occurrence was checked as I Detransitive Part. Pass., following the glossary's quadriliteral I label. Initial m- does not warrant moving it to III or changing the existing paradigm.
mʕartamto modifies hawa in the b-phrase and expresses a dark-weather state. There is no overt darkening agent or finite becoming event. The literal weather use fits Detransitive sense 1.
8/20 is already the single full Part. Pass. quotation; no duplicate example, new weather sense or idiom is added. The inherited face-darkening Preterit and ʕtm cross-reference remain unchanged.
Does the weather adjective specifically denote overcast conditions or general darkness? The Turoyo context and the edition's finster establish darkness but do not separate these shades of meaning.
